family: R30 R-DIAGNOSTIC: outlier-robust (winsorized) calibrate-first on v40 predictions (local only, tests v41 prescription calibrate-half cheaply without new training)
hypothesis: v40 rank kept (+0.052) but post-hoc clip +-0.02 saturated 95% at cap -> selection noise (monthly ~0.02%). Naive isotonic on raw val labels blows to +-2.5% (Y min -2.43/max +2.50 global fit) driven by val tails beyond +-3% (31.57% of pooled val mass). Winsorize val labels at +-1.0 (percent points) before causal isotonic fit on winsorized-val-only should tame blowup to +-1.0 while preserving rank (monotone) and coverage via same v40 policy floor + top-8 fallback.

winsor.cap_units: label percent-points (labels ch0 unconditional net percent; 1.0 = 1%)
winsor.method: clip(val_label_ch0, -1.0, +1.0) applied to y only before isotonic fit; x (scores) untouched; causal val-only (eligible history intersect pooled-val, past-only, embargo 8d)

step1_distribution_before_choosing.note: Compute pooled-val label distribution BEFORE freezing cap; val-only (unique 4316 validation rows from indices.npz across 33 jobs), no test peek
step1_distribution_before_choosing.justification: -1.0 ~= 30.83rd pct, +1.0 ~= 73.80th pct; central 42.97% retained exact; 57.03% tails winsorized including 31.57% beyond +-3 that drove naive iso Y to -2.43/+2.50 (~+-3% blowup). Cap +-1.0 limits iso Y to +-1.0, tames blowup 2.5x while preserving order; aggressive but outlier-robust by design (v41 prescription).

step2_freeze_cap.note: Cap frozen AFTER distribution (step1 hash 6a9cc2... computed first, val-only, no test). Runtime script recomputes distribution, verifies hash, then freezes cap; both hashes recorded in summary with order proof.

naive_blowup_reference.note: Non-causal global isotonic (all 4076 test scores -> test labels, analysis-only, NOT used for policy) maps to -2.43/+2.50 ~= +-3% blowup; motivates winsor. Causal per-fold fits recorded in calibrators.json.

calibration.method: causal-isotonic past-only on winsorized-val-only (IsotonicRegression out_of_bounds=clip; per-fold independent, past-only, embargo 8d)
calibration.score: selection_score_percent (mean 3 seeds, unconditional net, same units as v40 audit; x untouched)
calibration.target: labels[...,0] net percent winsorized to [-1.0,+1.0] (clip y only; 0 if unfilled retained unless beyond cap)
calibration.mapping: IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds=clip) fit on (x=score[mask].ravel(), y=winsor(labels[mask].ravel())); output mapped unconditional; conditional for choose = mapped / mean_fill_score; fill kept as mean_fill_score
calibration.val_only: mask = eligible_history(part, asof, left, 8d) AND is_pooled_val (global idx in 4316 unique validation rows); no test peek (current fold excluded); proof eligible_all==eligible_val over part recorded per-fold but mask explicitly val-only
calibration.warmup: WAIT (mapped=zeros for warmup fold; gate >0 fails -> no signals in that fold; fallback also WAIT in warmup)
calibration.thresholds_from: Same v40 policy floor (no validation-percentile replacement): gate en_best_cal > 0.0 + fallback top-8/fold-test on calibrated en_best; ranking in fold uses no labels (causal)

v40-identity.calibration: none (control, capped predictions as exported clip +-0.02)
v40-identity.gate: en_best_capped > 0.0 + fallback top-8/fold-test (pre-spec v40 policy_mechanism; gate_hits/fallback_adds recorded per-fold)
v40-identity.candidate: deterministic_best_index eps=1e-6 fill-desc holding-asc among fill>=0.25 (fill-eligible restricted, cfg fill>=0.25 kept; ineligible masked to -inf before tie-break)
v40-identity.fallback: top-8/fold-test when gate <8 (pre-spec plan N_MIN_PER_FOLD_TEST 8; bindings recorded)
v40-identity.note: Must reproduce R-audit rank_en_1x normal within 1e-9 (total_return/max_drawdown) + exact trades/signals (135/89) or STOP

v40-winsor-calibrated.calibration: causal-isotonic winsorized-val-only (cap +-1.0, per-fold, past-only, embargo 8d, IsotonicRegression clip)
v40-winsor-calibrated.gate: SAME v40 policy floor on calibrated: en_best_cal (mapped max) > 0.0 + fallback top-8/fold-test on calibrated en_best (bindings recorded separately)
v40-winsor-calibrated.candidate: SAME deterministic_best_index eps=1e-6 fill-desc holding-asc among fill>=0.25 on calibrated expected
v40-winsor-calibrated.fallback: top-8/fold-test when gate <8 on calibrated (pre-spec; bindings recorded per-fold; ranking in fold uses no labels)
